about:
Founded in 1981 in Goffstown, New Hampshire, New Hampshire Steel Fabricators (NHSF, LLC) began as a custom steel fabrication shop serving the construction industry. The company operates as a limited liability company and has grown to serve clients across New England.

The shop provides design, fabrication, and installation of miscellaneous metals packages, focusing on custom architectural metalwork. Its capabilities include structural and miscellaneous steel fabrication, welding, layout and fit-up of assemblies, and the creation of submittal and fabrication drawings. The company also offers detailed drafting, engineering, and cost estimating for raw materials, fabrication, and installation by line item.

NHSF serves the construction industry, supplying custom metal packages to general contractors and architects. A recent project includes the David Rubenstein Treehouse at Harvard University, where the fabricator worked with the Consigli/Smoot Joint Venture as contractor and Studio Gang as architect.

The company states its commitment to complete customer satisfaction, emphasizing skillful craftsmanship to the highest industry standards and competitive pricing to maintain project budgets.
